annotations.title: Current weather and hourly forecast for any coordinates

description: Weather for any point on Earth by latitude and longitude: current temperature in Celsius, conditions (clear, cloudy, rain, snow), precipitation in mm, wind speed and direction, humidity, cloud cover and air pressure, plus an hourly forecast for up to 48 hours. Data from the Norwegian Meteorological Institute. Use for travel and event planning, logistics, agriculture and any agent that needs the weather. Example: lat=59.33, lon=18.07, hours=12. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

hours.description: Hours of hourly forecast to return, 1-48 (default 12)
